summary: Delivery presence dates an assessment's state from the readers' clock, so its test holds one instant instead of comparing two system-clock reads a millisecond apart

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes; the since time is in-memory only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or API change. The readers' clock is the system clock unless a clock snapshot or a test holds it.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
